Source:
This module converts rotational and linear forces From force modules such as Curl Noise Force (Transient.PhysicsForce, and Transient.PhysicsRotationalForce, respectively)  into rotational and linear velocity. 

Optionally, Converts the Transient.PhysicsForce value generated by Force modules and applies it to initial particle positions. Can be thought of as a "warmup" of forces affecting the initial state of particle positions from time < 0.

If the forces have been converted to Velocity/Orientation (Write to Intrinsic Properties is checked in the advanced tab which means the force was applied to velocity), then zero out Transient.PhysicsForce and Transient.PhysicsRotationalForce
Translation:
此模块将旋度噪声力等力模块产生的旋转力和线性力，分别转换为角速度和线速度。

还可以将力模块产生的线性力应用于粒子的初始位置，相当于预先计算时间小于 0 时力对粒子位置的影响，即对初始位置进行“预热”。

如果已将这些力转换为速度或朝向（在“高级”选项中勾选“写入内置属性”），则会将累计的瞬态物理力和瞬态旋转力清零。
